div.head: VIII Atr 3
div.ab: And gif hit þonne to bote gega ⁊ se cyngc þæt geþafige, þonne bete man þæt ciricgrið into ðare circan, be þæs cyninges fullan mundbryce, ⁊ þa mynsterclænsunge begite, swa þarto gebirige, [⁊ ægþer ge mægbote ge manbote fullice gebete], ⁊ wið God huru þingian georne.

And if it comes to the payment of compensation and the king allows this course, amends for the violation of the protection of the church shall be made by the payment to the church in question of the full fine for breach of the king's "mund," and the purification of the church shall be carried out as is fitting, [and compensation both to the kin and to the lord of the slain man shall be fully paid], and, above all, supplication shall earnestly be made to God.

⁊ gyf hit þonne to bote gega, ⁊ se cyng þæt geþafige, þonne bete man þæt cyricgrið into þære cyrican, be cynges fullan mundbrice ⁊ þa mynsterclænsunge begyte, swa ðerto gebirige, ⁊ ægþer ge mægbote gc manbote fullice gebete ⁊ wið God huru þingie georne.
